name: Shed Arsenal
hook: Out-engineer the Pentagon using duct tape, leaf blowers, and riding mowers
tagline: A suburban dad in safety goggles welds lawn equipment and roman candles onto a rusty riding mower to rival trillion-dollar tech. Cash out to kill the throttle and coast safely into the tool shed before the HOA spots you. Hold too greedily and the nitro-boosted weed-whacker engine detonates, blasting lawn clippings across three subdivisions.
